runtime_confidence.note: Calibration measures reliability against benchmark labels, not factual verification.

selection_rule: Retain Logistic Regression when Linear SVC's macro-F1 advantage on the 1,200-row validation-policy partition is below 0.01; the untouched final test is excluded from model retention, calibration, and threshold selection.
feature_leakage_controls: deterministic word-five-gram candidate screening with exact Jaccard verification
two contaminated holdout rows quarantined before validation and final-test use
zero detected cross-partition near-duplicate pairs after controls
Reuters and byline markers neutralised consistently
TF-IDF fitted only inside the training Pipeline
final test excluded from fitting, calibration, model retention, and threshold selection
limitations: ISOT outlet, topic, period, and writing-style artefacts remain. Approximate near-duplicate screening is not exhaustive, and the final test is in-domain. This system estimates linguistic credibility risk; it is not an evidence-retrieval fact-checker and does not prove truth.
